scenes.title: Running Python Scripts & Scheduled Jobs
scenes.narration: Turning a Python script into a dependable scheduled job is how data pipelines move from experiment to production.

scenes.title: From Script to Job
bullets: Always invoke the script with the environment's own Python interpreter.
Read configuration and secrets from environment variables, not hard-coded values.
Log clearly and exit with a non-zero status when something fails.
scenes.narration: A production job must run with the exact Python from its virtual environment, so the right packages are available. It should pull configuration and secrets from environment variables rather than baking them into the code. And it must log meaningfully and signal failure with a non-zero exit code, so a scheduler can tell success from silent breakage.

scenes.title: A Production-Ready Script
scenes.narration: This script reads its database URL from the environment, keeping secrets out of the code. It uses the logging module so every run leaves a clear trail rather than bare prints. The main function holds the real work, guarded under the name-equals-main check. Crucially, any exception is logged and the script exits with status one, which is the signal a scheduler needs to detect a failed run.

scenes.title: Scheduling It with Cron
scenes.code:
# run nightly using the venv's python
0 3 * * * cd /app && /app/venv/bin/python etl.py >> /var/log/etl.log 2>&1
scenes.narration: This cron entry runs the job every night at three. It first changes into the project directory, then calls the interpreter inside the virtual environment by its full path so the correct dependencies load. Redirecting both standard output and errors into a log file ensures nothing is lost when the job runs unattended.

scenes.text: A production job needs three things: the right interpreter, clear logs, and a proper exit code so failures are never silent.
scenes.narration: Reliable scheduled jobs share the same essentials: run with the correct interpreter, log everything, and exit with a status that makes failures visible.
